name: SLT National Data Centre, Pitipana
notes: Official SLT announcement says the Pitipana/Homagama national data centre opened on 2018-01-16 with 500 racks and up to 5 kW per rack; capacity_mw is inferred IT rack load. DatacenterMap lists the site in Colombo market.

name: Dialog Tier III Data Center and Media Hub, Malabe
notes: Dialog official release describes the Malabe facility as Sri Lanka's first Tier III certified data center and media hub. DatacenterMap corroborates a Dialog Malabe facility in the Colombo market.

name: Dialog CDC, Piliyandala
notes: DatacenterMap lists Dialog CDC at Piliyandala in the Colombo market. Dialog's business data-center pages corroborate Dialog Smart Data Centers but do not provide a public MW figure.

name: OrionStellar Data Centre, Orion City Colombo
notes: DCD reported OrionStellar opened a 1.5MW data center in Colombo's Orion City IT park; OrionStellar's site describes its Colombo data-centre services.

name: Seylan Bank Data Centre, Colombo
notes: Sri Lankan business press reported Seylan Bank opened a new state-of-the-art data centre in Colombo in 2021; no public MW capacity found.

name: OREL IT Data Centre, Colombo Port City
developer: OREL IT / Colombo Port City Economic Commission
notes: Daily Mirror reported OREL IT signed an agreement with Port City Colombo including a data centre, innovation incubator and international delivery hub; Port City regulator news listing corroborates the agreement context. MW not disclosed.
